info.title: aqua — AquaCulture.Net 1.2.0 command-line tool · Made by Gravicode Studios, led by Kang Fadhil
info.description: AquaCulture.Net command-line tool: water quality, feeding, growth and harvest forecast, pond oxygen, disease diagnosis, MSY/YPR, weather impact, BMKG / NASA POWER / marine connectors, Parquet/CSV export, OPC UA simulator, Modbus/LoRaWAN decoding, RAS design, reports and the AquaAgent. Made by Gravicode Studios, led by Kang Fadhil.
